NOTE
**Still not ready — commits and screenshots still don't meet the guidelines**

New: Author squashed the fixup commits down to two and said the messages were rewritten. Missing: The commit titles are still "fix for issue 17419" and "added test case for issue 17418" (wrong issue number), with the test in a separate commit from the fix. The before/after screenshots were also not redone, and the author pushed back on them even though the change affects how rendered code blocks look and copy.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and leave it with laurynmm, who gave the feedback; don't assign a reviewer yet.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the update! The commits still need to follow our [commit discipline](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/commit-discipline.html): put the test in the same commit as the fix, and give the commit a proper `markdown:` title and a message that explains why. This change does affect rendered code blocks, so please also add precise before/after screenshots following [this guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/presenting-visual-changes.html#what-are-precise-before-after-screenshots), for example the same message rendered before and after with whitespace shown.
```
